The fail-closed guard read an empty API_KEY and correctly allowed the request, while the operator had set one — the guard was right and the environment lied to it. Anything the app reads from process.env belongs in this list.  ——  `build` declares `generated/**` as an OUTPUT and `prisma/**` as an INPUT because of a defect that was reproduced rather than imagined: @thornbury/commerce-api builds with `prisma generate && tsc`, and the generated Prisma clients are gitignored. Declared neither way, a cache hit restored dist/** WITHOUT generated/**, and every file in dist/ requires ../../generated/shop at runtime — so `pnpm build` printed FULL TURBO and left a dist that throws MODULE_NOT_FOUND on boot. Editing a .prisma file also invalidated nothing. Local `pnpm typecheck` hides both, because that package's typecheck script runs `generate` itself first. Harmless for the other packages: none of them has a generated/ or prisma/ directory.
